claim_boundary: This is an inference-only supervised ImageNet-1K reference under the same frozen-feature datasets, preprocessing, classifiers, splits, and metrics as the bounded Vision 1B diagnostic. It compares downstream representation quality under this probe but not self-supervised method quality, label efficiency, data efficiency, compute efficiency, or model scale.

evaluation.preprocessing: repeat grayscale to RGB, bicubic resize to 224x224, ImageNet mean/std normalization

ridge_probe.selection: deterministic stratified 80/20 split of the official training set; refit on all training examples after lambda selection
